findings.title: Empty observations corrupt the training objective and score
findings.evidence: Nonempty training score -12.54644775390625 becomes -3.4028234663852886e38 with one empty sequence and -inf with two. A zero-sequence batch is accepted with score0 and an optimization history entry.
findings.impact: Restart ranking and convergence can be dominated by the empty-sequence sentinel instead of observed data.
findings.recommendation: Define and enforce empty-input semantics before mutation: reject empty training batches; either reject empty entries or make supported empty entries neutral in summed objectives.

findings.title: Missing refinement context is rejected after joint training mutates weights
findings.evidence: optimizer_initialization=current, max_iter1, context_dim1, transition_refine_steps1 and context=None raises ValueError after weights have changed.
findings.impact: An invalid request returns failure with a partially updated model.
findings.recommendation: Validate refinement prerequisites before any initialization or optimizer step; assert state preservation on invalid requests.

findings.title: Internal encoder Float64 conversion fails because observations are forced to Float32
findings.evidence: model.double().log_likelihood(float64 observations) raises RuntimeError: Input type (float) and bias type (double) should be the same.
findings.impact: The regular nn.Module dtype conversion fails for the internal-encoder path.
findings.recommendation: Use the live model parameter dtype/device consistently at input and restart boundaries, and verify encoder Float64 plus Float32 controls.

findings.title: Noncausal segment emission sums clip valid Float64 density and gradients
findings.evidence: K1,D1,x1e20,Gaussian mean0, variance softplus(0): expected LL -7.213475493573564e39; noncausal LL -3.4028234663852886e38 and mean gradient0. Causal finite/tail controls retain the density and nonzero gradient.
findings.impact: The segment score cap changes the estimator for finite Float64 values beyond the Float32 lower bound; Viterbi does not use the same cap.
findings.recommendation: Remove categorical score clipping from accumulated continuous emission likelihoods; test independent density and gradient agreement.
findings.scope: Extreme Float64 counterexample. Moderate Float32 controls agree; no evidence that this affected the standardized frozen Trading artifact.

findings.title: Causal normalization creates NaNs for zero evidence and the public wrapper hides them
findings.evidence: A valid-shaped SequenceSet with K1 emissions[-inf,0] produces two NaN alpha entries; the public likelihood wrapper returns finite Float32 minimum.
findings.impact: A mathematically impossible event becomes NaN internally and a finite sentinel externally.
findings.recommendation: Guard zero normalizers and preserve impossible evidence or raise a clear support error; test parity with the validating filter.
findings.scope: Exact-zero emission support supplied through the public forward score container/custom component extension, rather than the stock positive Gaussian density.

findings.title: Finite noncausal Viterbi returns an arbitrary path when no terminal path exists
findings.evidence: Supported injected Duration subclass hard-masks to duration2; T1 has LL -inf, yet decode returns[0].
findings.impact: A returned path need not have positive support under the same model.
findings.recommendation: Check terminal MAP score finiteness before backtracking; cover finite/tail and duration-independent/dependent transitions.

findings.title: Empty-sequence forward and prediction contracts disagree across branches
findings.evidence: Causal forward returns shape[1,0,1,1]; finite noncausal forward raises IndexError and tail noncausal raises stack-empty RuntimeError. predict(mode=log_likelihood) returns a list for T0 whereas direct log_likelihood returns Tensor.
findings.impact: Dispatch changes shape/type or raises implementation errors for empty data rather than applying an explicit contract.
findings.recommendation: Handle emptiness consistently before branch-specific recursion, and dispatch likelihood mode before Viterbi-specific empty returns.
